text: Assets are defined in code, describing what should exist and how to produce/update them
quote: An asset definition is a description, in code, of an asset that should exist and how to produce and update that asset.

text: Official create-dagster CLI can scaffold a new Dagster project
quote: uvx create-dagster@latest project my-project

text: Asset checks can validate column null constraints, verify schema conformance, and detect if data needs refreshing
quote:
Ensure a particular column doesn't contain null values
*   Verify that a tabular asset adheres to a specified schema
*   Check if an asset's data needs refreshing

text: Asset checks are a testing framework to run data quality checks on assets
quote: Asset checks are tests that verify specific properties of your data assets, allowing you to execute data quality checks on your data.

text: Asset check results appear in the UI with customizable metadata and severity levels
quote: View asset check results in the UI**: Asset check results will appear in the UI and can be customized through the use of metadata and severity levels

text: Schedules automate job execution at set intervals, including cron expressions
quote: Schedules enable automated execution of jobs at specified intervals. These intervals can range from common frequencies like hourly, daily, or weekly, to more complex patterns defined using cron expressions.

text: Sensors trigger actions in response to internal or external events
quote: Sensors enable you to take action in response to events that occur either internally within Dagster or in external systems.

text: Declarative Automation launches asset executions based on asset status and dependency information
quote: Declarative Automation is a framework that uses information about the status of your assets and their dependencies to launch executions of your assets.

text: Dagster UI/APIs can run subsets of dbt models, seeds, and snapshots
quote: Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.

text: Integration lets Dagster trigger and orchestrate Airbyte syncs, chaining them with other pipeline steps
quote: Using this integration, you can trigger Airbyte syncs and orchestrate your Airbyte connections from within Dagster, making it easy to chain an Airbyte sync with upstream or downstream steps in your workflow.

text: FivetranAccountComponent represents Fivetran connectors as Dagster assets
quote: provides a FivetranAccountComponent which can be used to easily represent Fivetran connectors as assets in Dagster

text: DltLoadCollectionComponent represents dlt sources and pipelines as Dagster assets
quote: provides a DltLoadCollectionComponent which can be used to easily represent a collection of dlt sources and pipelines as assets in Dagster

text: Dagster+ alerts notify users of critical deployment events so issues can be caught early
quote: Dagster+ alerts can notify you of critical events occurring in your deployment so you can catch potential issues early, helping you resolve problems before they impact your stakeholders.

text: Dagster+ alert policies can target capacity metrics like queued/in-progress runs over a rolling window
quote: In Dagster+, alert policies can now target deployment capacity metrics — queued runs and in-progress runs — evaluated over a rolling window with aggregations such as max.

text: A typical Docker deployment runs long-lived containers for webserver, daemon, and each code location, enabling self-hosting
quote: A typical Dagster Docker deployment includes a several long-running containers: one for the webserver, one for the daemon, and one for each code location.

text: Dagster maintains a dagster-expert AI skill giving coding agents context and patterns for building Dagster projects
quote: Dagster maintains the `dagster-expert` skill in the dagster-io/skills repository. It provides expert guidance for building production-quality Dagster projects

text: Dagster+ MCP server lets an AI session access information and take actions in a Dagster+ deployment
quote: The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.

text: dg scaffold defs CLI command scaffolds new Dagster Component definitions with a defs.yaml file
quote: You can scaffold Dagster Component definitions in your project from the command line with the `dg scaffold defs` command, which will create a new directory inside your `defs/` folder that contains a `defs.yaml` file.

text: Existing projects can be migrated to a components-ready dg project structure
quote: you must either create a components-ready Dagster project or migrate an existing project to dg

text: Assets can be defined as plain Python functions using the @dg.asset decorator
quote: import dagster as dg@dg.assetdef hello(context: dg.AssetExecutionContext):    context.log.info("Hello!")@dg.asset(deps=[hello])

text: A single Dagster asset can encapsulate an entire Extract, Transform, Load process
quote: Creating a single Dagster asset that encapsulates the entire Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process

text: Published pricing includes a $10/month Solo plan with a 30-day free trial
quote: Solo Plan $10 per month Personal projects and simple pipelines ... 30-day free trial

text: Automation condition evaluations show the historical values behind history-dependent conditions for explainability
quote: Automation condition evaluations now explain history-dependent conditions (since, newly_true, newly_missing) by showing the remembered values that determined them

text: Wiping/deleting dynamic partitions in one action now supports multi-partitioned assets
quote: wiping and deleting dynamic partitions in a single action now also supports multi-partitioned assets that use the dynamic partitions definition as a dimension

text: Users declare asset-producing functions in Python and Dagster runs them at the right time to keep assets up-to-date
quote: With Dagster, you declare—as Python functions—the data assets that you want to build. Dagster then helps you run your functions at the right time and keep your assets up-to-date.

text: dg dev auto-generates and serves documentation for all components in a project's code location
quote: To see automatically generated documentation for all components in your environment, you can run `dg dev` to start the webserver and navigate to the `Docs` tab for your project's code location

text: Dagster's dbt integration can model existing dbt tests as Dagster asset checks
quote: Dagster's dbt integration can model existing dbt tests as asset checks.

text: AutomationCondition.on_cron executes an asset on each cron tick only after upstream dependencies have updated
quote: The AutomationCondition.on_cron will execute an asset once per cron schedule tick, after all upstream dependencies have updated.

text: ECS agent registers and reconciles code server tasks in AWS Cloud Map on a configurable interval
quote: the agent registers code server tasks in Cloud Map directly and reconciles them on an interval, configurable with the new `service_discovery_reconcile_interval` option (default 300 seconds)

text: fetch_column_metadata() emits column-level lineage for dbt snapshots on dbt 1.12+
quote: `fetch_column_metadata()` now emits column lineage for dbt snapshots on dbt 1.12 and later

text: Dagster auto-detects the installed dbt engine and supports migrating from dbt-core to dbt Fusion
quote: Dagster will automatically detect which engine you have installed. If you're currently using core, to migrate uninstall dbt-core and install dbt Fusion.
